---
name: review-agent-instructions
description: "Use when reviewing requirement/design/implementation consistency and producing severity-based findings."
applyTo: ["docs/operations/reviews/**"]
---
# Review Agent Instruction

- Classify findings as Must Fix, Should Fix, or Nice to Have.
- Prioritize user impact and regression risk.
- If no Must Fix exists, still state residual risks and test gaps.
- Keep judgment traceable to requirement and validation evidence.
